verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform stores scan findings in the cloud, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for this product. The evidence never mentions region selection or data residency. Local-only scanning and the --dry-run flag, which keeps results out of the web app, are adjacent privacy controls, not a choice of storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
